mu_name_from: MuPlayer.PartsForClass in the old client: the body a class wears with no armour equipped is HelmClass{NN}, ArmorClass{NN}, PantClass{NN}, GloveClass{NN}, BootClass{NN}. The numbering runs one over MU's zero-based classes, so Class01 is the Dark Wizard, Class02 the Dark Knight and Class03 the Fairy Elf.
part_note: The legs, 340 triangles. Bound to 90 on Bip01 L Thigh, 90 on Bip01 R Thigh, 57 on Bip01 Pelvis, 32 on Bip01 Spine, 14 on Bip01 L Calf, 14 on Bip01 R Calf.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQSkinClass103.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Fairy Elf's parts name it.
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Fairy Elf body, read out of Data/Player/PantClass03.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's PantClass03 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("now fairy elf, then MG"). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.

uv_overrides.why: The thighs under the garters, the sheet's bottom-left block.

uv_overrides_why: The shorts are cloth; the garter piece is bare thigh with a green band painted on, and goes to skin. Read off the sheet with the UV layout drawn over it (2026-10-15).
material_note: cloth for the green shorts, skin for the thighs, by uv_overrides.
